versions.changelog: YouTube video language and captions: controls.youtubeLanguage (BCP-47 code) and controls.youtubeCaptionKey (an .srt or .vtt upload via contentType application/x-subrip or text/vtt, max 10MB, needs a language), the four new error codes, and a new example youtube-video-captions.json.
TikTok photo posts take up to 10 images through PostFast (TikTok itself allows 35); no post carries more than 10 media items on any platform.

Synced to the live PostFast API (verified 2026-10-04): per-endpoint rate limits with the full table, headers and 429 behaviour (blocked calls still count); socialMediaIds and ids filters on GET /social-posts; bulk delete (POST /social-posts/bulk-delete) and what deleting does; Fair Usage posting limits incl. X per plan; Threads topic (threadsTopicTag); Instagram and YouTube AI labels; TikTok sounds on videos; TikTok first comment up to 1,200 chars; refreshed media limits (Bluesky video, X video, LinkedIn 10 images) and the accepted upload content types; Social Inbox idempotency keys and error codes.

Docs hardening: the 403 troubleshooting no longer shows auth headers carrying a key value and no longer tells you to echo the key (presence check instead), plus an explicit confirm-before-destructive-actions rule and connect-link handling note.

Connect link now documents platform scoping, the redirectUrl return-URL contract (status, platform, accountId, externalId) and externalId, with the live 400 codes. Verified against the production API; matches postfast-mcp 0.6.0.
Inbox conversations: postPreview (caption, thumbnail, public permalink where available; null on Instagram) documented — link users straight to the commented post
TikTok trending sounds: tiktok-sounds helper endpoint (list_tiktok_sounds MCP tool, postfast-mcp 0.4.0) + tiktokMusicSoundId/Name create_posts controls, mutual-exclusivity and rotation gotchas
Inbox duplicate guard: vary-wording rejection is an instruction to rephrase, not a retry; reply sends rate-limited per workspace
Social Inbox: comments API + MCP tools (postfast-mcp 0.3.0) — list/reply/private-reply/hide/status/assign, server-computed reply capability
Instagram saveRate + reelsSkipRate analytics on latestMetric; version + Hermes Agent (agentskills.io) frontmatter metadata; synced to postfast-mcp 0.1.24 API surface

TikTok firstComment now supported (Business accounts, 150 char max, comments enabled). tiktokPrivacy marked deprecated/no-op. Added video watch-time analytics (avgWatchTimeSeconds/totalWatchTimeSeconds/videoViews + TikTok extras). Added follower-history endpoint (daily snapshots; covers all platforms except X/personal FB, incl. TikTok).

Add the link field (the place's Facebook Page URL, nullable) to the search-places response shape in SKILL.md and api-reference.md, matching the complete API response (id, name, link, city, country, street, zip, pictureUrl).

Add place geotagging. New GET /social-media/search-places endpoint; geotag controls facebookPlaceId and instagramLocationId (the same place ID works on both networks) plus display-only facebookPlaceName/instagramLocationName. Add facebookTargetCountries country gating and tiktokTitle for photo carousels. Document geo validation error codes, the my-social-accounts followerCount field, per-platform character limits, and add facebook-geotag and instagram-geotag examples.

Account connection status: list accounts documents connectionStatus (CONNECTED/DISABLED) + disabledReason; scheduling to a disconnected account returns 400 socialMediaDisconnected (drafts still allowed); list posts lastError.code adds MISSED_DISCONNECTED / MISSED_NOT_PUBLISHED. Additive, backward compatible.

Add 'Common mistake' callout to draft section: status is a top-level field, not per-post. Putting it inside the post object causes API to default to SCHEDULED and reject request for missing scheduledAt.

Clarified PostFast draft (status: DRAFT) vs TikTok app draft (tiktokIsDraft) - they're separate concepts. Added examples/draft-post.json for the platform-agnostic case. Renamed tiktok-draft.json -> tiktok-app-draft.json. Tightened tiktokIsDraft control reference.

Remove xCommunityId control. X is retiring Communities on 2026-05-30; the X API has been rejecting community_id payloads intermittently since Feb 2026. Existing posts in the DB still publish (to user timeline instead of Community); new payloads with controls.xCommunityId will now be rejected as an extra field.

Add Pinterest analytics: lifetime canonical fields (impressions, likes/reactions, comments), 90-day rolling saves in canonical shares, plus extras for pin_clicks, outbound_clicks, *_90d siblings, engagement metrics, save_rate, and video metrics (video_mrc_views, video_avg_watch_time, video_v50_watch_time, video_10s_views, video_start, quartile_95_percent_view). Requires Pinterest business account.
Remove xQuoteTweetUrl control — BE field deprecated per X API quote-post removal. xRetweetUrl (retweet-only) unaffected.

Add custom cover image support (coverImageKey) for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and Pinterest video. Fix coverTimestamp unit from seconds to milliseconds. New example: instagram-reel-cover.json. 26 gotchas, 26 examples.
Add Google Business Profile (GBP) support: new platform with 3 post types (Standard, Event, Offer), GBP locations endpoint, 9 control fields, 3 examples, media specs, and gotchas
Fix: API key format is base64 ending with '=', not pf_ prefix. Corrected troubleshooting examples.
Added Troubleshooting section: 403 auth errors (wrong header, unset env var, regenerated key), 401 missing key, 429 rate limits. Added auth warning to Setup section.
Added YouTube to supported analytics platforms (views, likes, comments, total interactions)
Re-publish to retrigger security scan.
Added instagramTrialReelStrategy control for Instagram trial reels (shown to non-followers first, auto-graduate after 72h). New example (instagram-trial-reel.json). 21 examples total.
Added tiktokIsAigc control for AI-generated content labeling. Added FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR to tiktokPrivacy enum. New example (tiktok-aigc-video.json).
Added youtubeThumbnailKey support: custom YouTube video thumbnails via S3 upload. New example (youtube-video-thumbnail.json), updated platform controls reference, API reference, and gotchas.
Add post analytics endpoint (GET /social-posts/analytics) - fetch published post metrics including impressions, reach, likes, comments, shares. Add analytics example.
Add post analytics endpoint (GET /social-posts/analytics) - fetch published post metrics including impressions, reach, likes, comments, shares. Add analytics example.
Re-publish v1.2.0 (security scan was stuck)

v1.2.0: Added connect-link endpoint, firstComment support, draft posts, approval workflow, X retweet/quote-tweet/community controls, Facebook Reel collaborators, YouTube categories, fixed pagination params (0-based page, limit not perPage), added GET filters (platforms/statuses/from/to), X 5-post daily API limit warning, 10 new examples (24 files total, up from 14)

v1.1.0: Added 8 ready-to-use JSON examples (cross-platform, TikTok, Instagram Reel, YouTube Short, Pinterest, LinkedIn document, batch scheduling, Telegram). Added 2 new reference docs (media-specs, upload-flow). Expanded SKILL.md 3x with common patterns, gotchas, quick reference cheat sheet. Added Telegram as 10th platform. Removed non-agent files.

Initial release of PostFast social media scheduling skill.

- Schedule and manage posts across 9 platforms: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), YouTube, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, and Pinterest.
- Upload and attach media to posts via a secure, 3-step signed URL workflow.
- Cross-post content to multiple social media accounts in a single request.
- List, view, and delete scheduled posts through dedicated endpoints.
- Access platform-specific controls and content options for advanced scheduling.
- Helper endpoints to fetch Pinterest boards and YouTube playlists.
- SaaS-based API — no self-hosting required.
